name: sterile alpha motif domain containing 9

function.text: SAMD9 encodes sterile alpha motif domain-containing protein 9. It participates in endosomal vesicle fusion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to SAMD9-related spectrum and myeloid neoplasm risk (autosomal dominant); MIRAGE syndrome (autosomal dominant).
